Djordje S Aničić

Lieutenant Colonel Aničić has more than 25 years of extensive experience serving in every role of the SAM-3 NEVA missile systems, from operator to commander. He was deputy commander of the 3rd Battalion, 250th Air Defense Missile Brigade and was one of the commanders in the combat shift that shot down the F-117A. He is the author of Smena (The Shift), an authentic war diary describing the day-by-day events of the 3rd Battalion during 78-days-long war.

Mike Mihajlovic

From Conservapedia
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Mike Mihajlovic is a Serbian ‑ Canadian military analyst, engineer , author , and commentator known for his technical breakdowns of modern warfare , missile systems, and air‑defense operations. His work spans engineering, military service, and public analysis across books, interviews, and platforms. He is a professional engineer and physicist with 25+ years of experience in government , consulting, and armed forces. He is known for detailed technical analysis of missile systems, stealth aircraft, and modern warfare.

Books

Some notable works include:
* Shooting Down the Stealth Fighter (with Djordje Aničić)
* Missileers Against the Stealth
* The Shift: Air Defense Missile Officer War Diary
